scope: Only the condition in existing ICollection<KeyValuePair<string,object?>>.Remove; preserve its branch and final Remove(key). F039 Contains and all other shipping code remain unchanged.
hypothesis: Replace ContainsKey plus non-consuming Peek with private Data.TryGetValue and the same stored-value-first object.Equals. Never use public IDictionary.TryGetValue, remove before equality, or bypass final retained-key maintenance and its returned Boolean.
behaviorContract: The real registered ITempData cascade during public RazorComponentResult execution must produce the source-built owner with its actual cookie-provider callback; no private constructor invocation, copied owner, new IVT or UnsafeAccessor.
The first cold Remove must invoke the actual cookie provider once; later operations must not reload.
Preserve present-null versus missing-null, case-insensitive keys, case-sensitive/asymmetric/throwing value equality, equality call direction/count and null-key exception.
Mismatched removal must not consume or delete a retained value. Successful removal must update both dictionaries and survive actual cookie-backed subsequent requests.
Preserve final Remove(key) result after value equality removes or replaces the entry reentrantly; a true equality result does not by itself guarantee a true removal result.
Every prepared benchmark call must return its declared result repeatedly and restore exactly the same nonempty cardinality; never time one removal followed by accidental misses.

benchmarkDesign.boundary: Prepared loaded real TempData RemoveAndRestore round trip: actual ICollection.Remove (or named unchanged string-key Remove control) then same target setter restoration for every nonempty profile. Restoration and its retained-key work are inside timing. Empty profiles are genuine misses and do not insert a value.
benchmarkDesign.fixture: Public result/registered cascade creates the real owner outside timing. Direct memory-response execution does not invoke endpoint persistence; the separate canonical sample covers persistence.
benchmarkDesign.keyAndValueDetails: Actual string keys, precomputed case-variant queries, distinct equal string objects, null target, genuine missing-null query, and prepared restoration key/value. Setup, evidence, validation and disposal are outside timing.
benchmarkDesign.controls: All empty profiles plus unchanged public string-key RemoveAndRestore at each count/key length. Runtime string-hash seeding remains unchanged and may differ by native member.
benchmarkDesign.discovery: Public non-sealed fixture and all forty cases must be found using actual BenchmarkConverter.TypeToBenchmarks before any measurement authorization.
benchmarkDesign.lifecycle: At least sixteen repeated calls for each of forty profiles must each return the expected Boolean and retain the same declared cardinality; successful nonempty calls must not degrade into misses.

sourceComparisons.settings: Observe and preserve initial process/thread priority and affinity in every native member/executor; never change VM power, OS, network, unrelated processes or measurement priority.
